== English Special Edition comparison ==
The physical site cancels opponent Force drains with separate prevention for your own drains in the Light text. Decipher's replacement bars either player from draining at this system and prevents the opponent from initiating Force drains at related locations when occupied by the controlling Dark player. Later Players Committee publications preserve the replacement text.
